entities.name: Dawnchaser Pilgrims
entities.description: Gold-clad nomadic religious order of Muraganda who follow dawn and venerate the sun.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: Plane across which the Dawnchaser Pilgrims travel.

entities.name: Summer City
entities.description: Magical site on Muraganda where the Pilgrims refill dawnlamps and celebrate.

entities.name: Winter City
entities.description: Magical site on Muraganda opposite the Summer City where the Pilgrims gather.

entities.name: Sundial
entities.description: Construct followed by the Dawnchaser Pilgrims.

events.summary: The Pilgrims gather twice a year in the Summer City and Winter City for week-long celebrations venerating the sun.
events.quote: hold week-long celebrations to venerate the sun

relations.note: The Pilgrims are known to follow it.
relations.quote: They are known to follow the construct Sundial
